evidence: Fig. 1 (a) shows the growth rates per cycle of T-ALD and PE-ALD La2O3 films as a function of precursor exposure time (ts) at a growth temperature (Ts) of 300 °C. In both cases, the figure shows that a saturated growth, which is one of the typical ALD characteristics, occurs at ts ≥3 s, indicating that the La(iPrCp) 3 precursor is suitable for ALD process.
